purpose: Targeted follow-up research to resolve or narrow the remaining import caveats after the first-pass overview and section research for Höga Kustenleden. This file is research-only and is not runtime app data.

agents.focus: protected areas, current notices, fire, closures, boundaries
facilities and service coordinates/currentness for sections 1-5
facilities and service coordinates/currentness for sections 6-9

overallResolutions.finding: DinTur is available through Trafiklab GTFS Sweden 3 / Regional GTFS, Trafiklab Stop Lookup / Timetables, and Stops data NeTEx, but these authoritative sources require an API key. The targeted pass resolved DinTur/Fskab stop-area IDs and WGS84 coordinates from DinTur's embedded planner. Treat these as good research-grade stop IDs, not final national ResRobot/Trafiklab stop IDs.
overallResolutions.recommendation: Use the DinTur/Fskab stop-area IDs below for research and candidate normalization notes. Replace with authoritative Trafiklab/ResRobot national stop IDs before automated transit import if a Trafiklab key is available.

overallResolutions.finding: No current authoritative 2026 Nationalparksbussen timetable was found. The current Skuleskogen official access page points to line 50 and lines 421/422. Höga Kusten FAQ still mentions Världsarvsbussen, but current travel pages do not provide a current timetable, and secondary current guidance says the World Heritage Bus ran in 2023.
overallResolutions.recommendation: Do not import or display a 2026 shuttle as active unless a new official timetable appears.

overallResolutions.finding: M/F Ulvön has current 2026 timetables including summer service 18 June-16 August 2026 from Köpmanholmen toward Ulvön, Trysunda and Strängöarna. Höga Kusten Båtarna has 2026 Ulvön service 15 June-16 August 2026 from Ullånger, Docksta and Mjällomslandet to Ulvöhamn and return. Högbonden 2026 service from Barsta/Bönhamn is active for 22 June-16 August.
overallResolutions.recommendation: Model these as optional seasonal onward/side access only, not as required trail crossings.

overallResolutions.finding: Länsstyrelsen Västernorrland showed no countywide fire ban on the access date. Fire-ban status is dynamic and can override all fireplace records.
overallResolutions.recommendation: Keep fireplace records caveated and recheck fire-ban status immediately before public display/import.

Apply Hörnsjön rules only to this urban-reserve segment.

currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.finding: Current official trail wording says passage through Slåttdalsskrevan is not recommended due to rockfall risk. No formal legal closure notice was found in the current official pages checked.
currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.recommendation: Model as hazard / avoid-through-passage / use current route, not as a legally closed segment unless a formal Länsstyrelsen closure notice is later found.

currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.finding: Länsstyrelsen page says no destination news, but Örnsköldsvik municipality has an active notice dated 2026-01-09: the lighted track is out of function until further notice. Naturguiden says lighting replacement is planned during 2026.
currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.recommendation: Carry a currentness caveat for possible work/terrain disturbance around Hörnsjön and recheck before public display.

currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.finding: The current section 7 GPX does not follow the cycling-permitted Kuststigen corridor except for a tiny near-overlap around km 6.17-6.25. Kuststigen is a separate 5.6 km blue trail.
currentnessAndSafetyResolutions.recommendation: Do not mark section 7 as cycling-permitted. Only model cycling permission if Kuststigen is imported as a separate route/corridor.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: Höga Kusten overview and section page list section 2 as 26.8 km. Naturkartan lists 23.7 km, while GPX/OSM computes about 24.8-24.9 km.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Use 26.8 km as the normalized displayed distance. Store computed geometry distance in metadata. Do not use Naturkartan 23.7 km as primary.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: The official section 4 end and section 5 start have a minor 20-25 m Ullånger endpoint mismatch.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Do not snap or redraw official geometry. Keep each official GPX endpoint aligned to its own route geometry. If a later route graph needs a shared logical node, add a logical junction/access point instead of editing the geometry.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: Official display distance is 20.8 km. Naturkartan GPX/API is the current primary geometry. Höga Kusten GPX has old split-track artifacts and a 72.6 m segment gap.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Display 20.8 km and use Naturkartan GPX/API as primary geometry. Do not blindly transfer Höga Kusten GPX elevations. If elevation is needed, prefer Naturkartan API elevation on the primary line; otherwise keep Höga Kusten elevation as contextual, caveated metadata.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: Höga Kusten says Medel, while Naturkartan/API says Röd - krävande. The terrain and Slåttdalsskrevan rockfall/upper-route context support the harder rating.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Normalize to Röd - krävande and preserve Höga Kusten Medel as an alternate-source caveat.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: Section 8 starts at Entré Nord, not Coop Köpmanholmen. Section 8 end and section 9 start are Balesuddens naturreservat / Sandlågan north access. Section 9 ends at Stadsträdgården, Örnsköldsvik; Resecentrum is access metadata, not the route endpoint.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Use these labels for normalized endpoints and keep Coop/Resecentrum as service/access metadata.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: Naturkartan URL slug says etapp-8, but page content is current Etapp 9. Höga Kusten visible section 9 page embeds the section 8 GPX. A direct hidden Höga Kusten section-9 GPX can corroborate the line, but Naturkartan GPX is the primary usable source.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Use Naturkartan GPX as primary. Do not use the visible Höga Kusten section-9 embedded GPX unless it is corrected.

geometryAndImportPolicy.finding: The existing app taxonomy supports attraction, viewpoint, rest-area, shelter, parking, transit and similar POIs, and runtime hides records whose route proximity is off-route.
geometryAndImportPolicy.recommendation: Import official short detours with good coordinates and clear hiker value as POIs with side-trip descriptions. Keep non-core logistics, weak buses, distant parking, private/uncertain huts, fishing-only POIs and more-than-2-km detours as access metadata or suppressed. Do not create fake mainline facilities solely because a side trip is famous.
